vocab.sentence: I spent only NT$100 getting ten giant packs of toilet paper. It was a real bargain!
The foreign tourist is bargaining with the street vendor over the price of the vase.
The driver is mad about the poor quality of the road. There are too many holes in it.
This company produces the best bicycles in the world.
Rafael Nadal started his tennis career at the age of 16.
We heard a loud explosion and saw that someone was making puffed rice cakes.
Because Megan shook the soda, it exploded when she opened the can.
Marcus was seriously injured after he fell down the stairs.
Because of her serious leg injury, Gill cannot walk now.
Andy's fingers were hurt, so I cooked instead.
To improve her English, Helen listens to English radio programs every day.
Although there is still room for improvement, Jules has done a good job running the business.
Mr. Hu is famous for his skill in decorating traditional temples.
The customer is demanding a refund for the broken hair dryer he bought yesterday.
The colorful masking tapes are the most popular products in this shop.
Stephen King is a productive writer. He has written more than fifty novels.
The hotel supplies its guests with umbrellas for free when it rains.
With the food in his hand, Nick succeeded in attracting the ducks to come near him.
The father read a bedtime story to his daughter in a gentle voice.

phrases.sentence: The dirty tables and walls in the restaurant scared many customers away.
Jack finally figured out why his friends were laughing at him—his T-shirt was inside out.
As a flower shop owner, Linda takes her job very seriously.
My grandpa takes a walk in the park every evening, rain or shine.
Cindy kept looking at Ray when he passed by the classroom.

notes.title: 形容詞最高級 (Superlatives)
examples: Nancy is the tallest in her family.
Mike is the best basketball player in Taiwan.

notes.title: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect)
examples: Charlie has collected all the trash.

quiz.question: This is the _______ bargain I have ever found in my career.
quiz.hint: 句中有 'ever'，表示經驗中的最高級。

quiz.question: Our company _______ its products to several countries for ten years.
quiz.hint: 配合 'for ten years' 使用現在完成式，主詞為單數。

quiz.question: Marcus _______ how to fix the machine since this morning.
quiz.hint: since 引導時間點，需用現在完成式。

quiz.question: Of all the workers, Stephen is the _______ writer in the office.
quiz.hint: 'Of all' 是最高級的關鍵字。

quiz.question: The heavy rain _______ all the customers away so far.
quiz.hint: 'so far' 是現在完成式的關鍵字。

quiz.question: This laptop is the _______ product in our shop this year.
My brother _______ in his new job as a doctor recently.
I heard that was the _______ explosion in the city’s history.
The boss _______ a higher quality of work from us since the project started.
quiz.hint: since 子句搭配現在完成式。

quiz.question: Rafael Nadal _______ many tennis games since he was 16.
quiz.hint: 主詞單數搭配 since 使用完成式。

quiz.question: She is the _______ person I have ever met; she always speaks in a low voice.
The road quality _______ a lot after the government fixed it.
quiz.hint: 表示目前已經改善完成的狀態。

quiz.question: This is the _______ improvement we have seen in our skill training.
quiz.hint: 程度「最大」的進步使用最高級。

quiz.question: Have you _______ why the machine exploded?
quiz.hint: Have + S + Vpp 構成完成式問句。

quiz.question: Cindy _______ her boss seriously since she joined the company.
My grandpa _______ a walk every evening, rain or shine, for 20 years.
Among the three runners, Ken is the _______ one.
Marcus _______ many injuries in his career so far.
quiz.hint: so far 搭配現在完成式 has + Vpp。

quiz.question: That was the _______ sound I have ever heard in my life.
quiz.hint: y 結尾形容詞最高級去 y 加 -iest。

quiz.question: The supply of clean water _______ since the explosion.
I _______ by the store many times, but I never went inside.
quiz.hint: 主詞 I 搭配 have + Vpp。

quiz.question: Is this the _______ price you can give me for this vase?
He _______ his English skills instead of playing games all day.

The manager _______ a refund for the broken product already.
This is the _______ quality of paper I have ever used in the office.
The athlete _______ many injuries since his career began.
Rafael Nadal is the _______ tennis player I have ever seen.
The customer _______ a full refund for the product several times so far.
Buying ten giant packs of toilet paper for NT$100 was the _______ bargain of the week.
Many tourists _______ by this street vendor since the morning.
This was the _______ injury Marcus has ever had in his career.
To _______ her skills, Helen _______ very hard lately.
quiz.hint: To+原形 V；lately 用完成式。

quiz.question: Stephen King is known as the _______ writer in the company.
The soda _______ in the car because it was too hot.
My mother has the _______ voice in my family.
The hotel _______ us with free umbrellas since it started raining.
Mr. Hu’s skill in decorating temples is the _______ in Taiwan.
As a shop owner, Linda _______ her job _______ for years.
quiz.hint: take seriously 搭配 for years 完成式。

quiz.question: He has had the _______ career among all the tennis players.
The loud noise _______ the birds _______ already.
This bicycle has the _______ quality of all the products here.
Jack _______ the problem _______ yet.
quiz.hint: yet 用於完成式否定句。
